uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

1957-4050-6578--173.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature castable for {0}, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3175-3991-4247.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2866-4708-4986-8095.description:
Cast Dark Sphere by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1594-4399-4770-7818.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Liliana the Faultless trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Liliana the Faultless trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-4399-4770-7818.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

215-969-3443.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
215-969-3443.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding an amount of {B} or {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-969-3443.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {B}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Deathbloom Ritualist

1575-5903-7627.description:
Activate Mushroom Watchdogs by sacrificing an artifact, which is a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Mushroom Watchdogs ability.
Repeat.

190-2225-4219.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Hivestone and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Because each opponent controls a Hivestone, their creatures are all Slivers and cannot attack due to having defender, which is granted by Dormant Sliver.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7297-7605.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7297-7605.description:
Cast Indulge by paying {2}{R}.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker. Indulge triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-7297-7605.notes: Afterwards, you can cast Excess from your graveyard for {1}{R} to create Treasures.

112-4872-6496.manaNeeded: {9}{U}{U}{U}{U} the first turn with {9}{U}{U}{U} each other turn
112-4872-6496.easyPrerequisites: You've cast exactly one spell this turn.
112-4872-6496.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Time Warp and exiling the original Time Warp with four time counters on it.
Resolve the Time Warp copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Time Warp and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat step 4 one additional time.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Time Warp's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Time Warp and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Time Warp's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.
112-4872-6496.notes: You can use Clockspinning as a way to cast a spell before starting the combo if needed. Since you need to ensure Time Warp is always the second spell cast each extra turn after Clockspinning, it is recommended to not have any other suspended cards when beginning the combo. Otherwise, you can ensure Time Warp is second by casting Clockspinning with the other suspend abilities on the stack during your upkeep.

955-3490-6723-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
955-3490-6723-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

877-2908-4254.description:
Cast Dream Stalker by paying {0}.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1978-2416-6893.description:
Animate The Eternity Elevator using Rise and Shine.
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat from step 2.
1978-2416-6893.notes: If The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it, you can instead use its second ability to get infinite colored mana. You can also use both interchangeably, if desired.

2079-4251-6911.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-4251-6911.description:
Declare Godo as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Godo, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Godo that isn't legendary.
When the Godo token enters, it triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment and put it onto the battlefield.
During your next combat phase, declare Godo and the Godo token as attackers.
The Godo token triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2292-4550-5567-6254--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
2292-4550-5567-6254--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

3151-4067-5672.easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
3151-4067-5672.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Elves.
3151-4067-5672.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Elvish Archdruid.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1497-3327-4613-5508.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1497-3327-4613-5508.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Railway Brawler triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Dargo.
Activate Dargo using Wild Cantor's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

560-2835-4550-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2835-4550-5147.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Fecundity triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities.
Repeat.

341-586-2511-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2919-3641-5641.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
2919-3641-5641.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

176-2921-5522.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other non-Spirit creature.
176-2921-5522.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing any other non-Spirit creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that enters the battlefield as a copy of Essence of the Wild.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

670-2996-3742-4681.notablePrerequisites: You have ventured into the Tomb of Annihilation twice, choosing the Veils of Fear room.
670-2996-3742-4681.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying {3}{U}.
Radiant Solar and Phantom Steed trigger.
Resolve Phantom Steed's trigger, exiling Karmic Guide until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve Radiant Solar's trigger, venturing into the Sandfall Cell room of Tomb of Annihilation.
Sandfall Cell triggers twice.
Resolve one Sandfall Cell trigger, sacrificing Phantom Steed and causing each other player to lose 2 life unless they sacrifice an artifact, creature, or land.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield as Phantom Steed's effect ends.
Radiant Solar and Karmic Guide trigger.
Resolve Karmic Guide's trigger, returning Phantom Steed from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Radiant Solar and Phantom Steed trigger.
Resolve Phantom Steed's trigger, exiling Karmic Guide until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room.
Cradle of the Death God triggers twice, creating two legendary tokens of The Atropal.
Put one of The Atropal tokens into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 8, venturing into the Trapped Entry room of Tomb of Annihilation.
Trapped Entry triggers twice, causing each player to lose a total of 2 life.
Resolve the remaining Sandfall Cell trigger from step 5, sacrificing Phantom Steed and causing each other player to lose 2 life unless they sacrifice an artifact, creature, or land.
Repeat steps 7 through 11.
Resolve one of Radiant Solar's triggers, venturing into the Veils of Fear room.
Veils of Fear triggers twice, causing each player to lose 2 life unless they discard a card, twice.
Repeat from step 4 as many times as the game state allows, choosing a different target in step 3 or 9 to end the loop if necessary.

1475-2034-2486.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional modified creature.
1475-2034-2486.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other modified creature you control with power one or greater, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering One with the Kami, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Each Spirit enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Repeat.

190-1321-3999.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Immortal Coil and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Activate Crook of Condemnation's second ability by paying {1} and exiling it, exiling all cards from all graveyards.
Each opponent's Immortal Coil triggers, causing them to lose the game.
